name: Clarice Eitengen
original_name: クラリス エイティンゲン
source: A Prussian soldier who acts together with Erwina. She is one of the second generation superhuman soldiers. However, unlike the first generation or her "sisters", Clarice is a failed experiment, and has no strength in her body to fight in wars at all.
